title: Notice Something Wrong on Your Statement? We Can Help
summary: This document explains how Rho-Bank customers can get help if something is wrong on their account statement, including missing rebates (due to system timing/processing delays) and fees incorrectly charged (e.g., monthly maintenance fee waived by minimum balance, ATM fee refund under benefits). It provides contact methods and service hours: call 1-800-RHO-BANK, visit rhobank.com/help, or chat via the mobile app; Mon–Fri 8 AM–8 PM and Sat 9 AM–5 PM.
faqs: What should I do if I notice something incorrect on my Rho-Bank statement?
Can you help if a rebate I’m eligible for is missing or not applied?
Why might a rebate not appear on my statement right away?
What if I was charged an unexpected fee—can you review and credit it?
Can you refund a monthly maintenance fee that should have been waived due to minimum balance?
How can I contact Rho-Bank customer service, and what are the hours?
